A MULTI-OMICS PERSPECTIVE

Considering the layers
of biology together.

DNA, RNA and epigenetic data illuminate different aspects of the same biological question. A multi-omics perspective helps place the relationships between these layers in a broader context.

DNA

Genomics

Genetic variants and genome structure.

Transcriptomics
